title: Disaggregated Quantization: Specializing LLM Prefill and Decode
abstract: arXiv:2609.26333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prefill and decode reward different approaches to quantization: low-precision arithmetic accelerates prompt processing, while compact weights reduce memory traffic during generation. We propose "disaggregated quantization" (DQ), which specializes computation formats, weights and storage placement to both of these phases. On Qwen 3 and Gemma 3, removing activation quantization specifically on decode improves accuracy on decode-heavy tasks without increasing inference cost. Training separate compute-native prefill weights accelerates prompt processing relative to weight-only inference while matching or exceeding its accuracy at 2-3-bit decode on both decode-heavy and prefill-heavy tasks. With released Qwen3.8-27B GGUF decoders, training an NVFP4 prefiller improves 1-bit accuracy by 32.5 points on MMLU-Pro and 35.3 on MMMU-Pro without modifying the decode checkpoint. translated_title: 解聚量化：面向大语言模型预填充与解码阶段的专门化设计
translated_abstract: 预填充和解码两个阶段各自适合不同的量化策略：低精度算术运算可加速提示词处理，而紧凑的权重可减少生成过程中的内存流量。我们提出“解聚量化”，该方法针对这两个阶段分别专门化计算格式、权重和存储布局。在 Qwen 3 和 Gemma 3 上，仅在解码阶段移除激活量化，可以在不增加推理成本的情况下提升解码密集型任务的准确率。训练单独的计算原生预填充权重，相比仅权重量化推理可以加速提示词处理，同时在解码密集型和预填充密集型两类任务上，于 2-3 位解码精度下达到相当甚至更高的准确率。基于已发布的 Qwen3.8-27B GGUF 解码器，训练一个 NVFP4 预填充器可以在不修改解码检查点的情况下，将 1 位精度在 MMLU-Pro 上提升 32.5 分、在 MMMU-Pro 上提升 35.3 分。为了在单个设备上容纳额外的检查点，卸载式解聚……
tldr: 提出“解聚量化”（DQ）方法，针对大语言模型预填充和解码两个阶段分别专门化计算格式、权重与存储布局，在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升推理速度与低比特精度（如在 Qwen3.8-27B 上将 1 位精度于 MMLU-Pro 提升 32.5 分）。
en_tdlr: Proposes "Disaggregated Quantization" (DQ), which specializes computation formats, weights, and storage placement separately for LLM prefill and decode phases, improving inference speed and low-bit accuracy at no extra cost—e.g., boosting 1-bit accuracy by 32.5 points on MMLU-Pro using an NVFP4 prefiller without modifying the decode checkpoint.
